cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. How do you feel about me inviting a few people to dinner?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. So standing guests would be more considerate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six. I've already invited them. Would borrowing enough chairs for everyone turn that into a yes?

mechanism: A confidently imitates a seating action without grasping its meaning, then solicits approval for the seat already taken.
confusable: D04 done act must precede approval; S04 copying must be causally responsible rather than decorative.
comparison: Event etiquette/status differs from buying a costly object.
seedUse: Use D04-b adapting an approval pitch to B's constraint, with S04-b misinterpreted situational behavior.
